sentences.content: So, Peter, how long have you been in China?
sentences.english: So , Peter , how long have you been in China ?
sentences.chinese: 那么，Peter，你来中国多久了？

sentences.content: I’ve been here for two weeks, but I’m going back to Australia tomorrow.
sentences.english: I've been here for two weeks , but I'm going back to Australia tomorrow
sentences.chinese: 我在这里已经待了两周，但明天就要回Australia了。

sentences.chinese: 是的，我有。我见过许多有趣的事物。

sentences.content: Have you visited the Palace Museum?

sentences.content: Yes, I have. I went there last week. It was wonderful. There were so many beautiful treasures.

sentences.chinese: 是的，我去过。上周刚去的，那里棒极了。有那么多精美的珍宝。

sentences.content: And have you been to the Great Wall?

sentences.content: Thank you for your time and have a safe trip home.

sentences.content: Have you ever been to Singapore?
sentences.english: Have you ever been to Singapore ?
sentences.chinese: 你去过新加坡吗？

wordDetails.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成时

sentences.content: For thousands of tourists from China, this small island in Southeast Asia is a wonderful and safe place to take a holiday.
sentences.english: For thousands of tourists from China , this small island in Southeast Asia is a wonderful and safe place to take a holiday
sentences.chinese: 对成千上万来自中国的游客而言，这个东南亚小岛是度假的理想胜地，既美妙又安全。

sentences.content: On the one hand, more than three quarters of the population are Chinese, so you can simply speak Putonghua a lot of the time.
sentences.english: On the one hand , more than three quarters of the population are Chinese , so you can simply speak Putonghua a lot of the time
sentences.chinese: 一方面，超过四分之三的人口是华人，因此很多时候你只需说普通话即可。

sentences.content: On the other hand, Singapore is an English-speaking country, so it’s also a good place to practice your English!
sentences.english: On the other hand , Singapore is an English-speaking country , so it's also a good place to practice your English !
sentences.chinese: 另一方面，新加坡是一个讲英语的国家，因此也是练习英语的好地方！

sentences.content: Have you ever tried Chinese food outside of China?
sentences.english: Have you ever tried Chinese food outside of China ?
sentences.chinese: 你在中国境外尝试过中餐吗？

sentences.content: Maybe you fear that you won’t be able to find anything good to eat when you travel.
sentences.english: Maybe you fear that you won't be able to find anything good to eat when you travel
sentences.chinese: 或许你担心旅行时会找不到可口的美食。

sentences.content: In Singapore, however, you’ll find a lot of food from China; you won’t have any problem getting rice, noodles or dumplings.
sentences.english: In Singapore , however , you'll find a lot of food from China ; you won't have any problem getting rice , noodles or dumplings
sentences.chinese: 然而在新加坡，你会发现许多来自中国的食物；要吃到米饭、面条或饺子完全不是问题。

sentences.content: Singapore is also an excellent place to try new food.
sentences.english: Singapore is also an excellent place to try new food
sentences.chinese: 新加坡也是品尝新美食的绝佳之地。

sentences.content: Whether you like Indian food, Western food or Japanese food, you’ll find it all in Singapore!
sentences.english: Whether you like Indian food , Western food or Japanese food , you'll find it all in Singapore !
sentences.chinese: 无论你喜欢印度菜、西餐还是日本料理，在新加坡都能找到！

sentences.content: Most large cities have zoos, but have you ever been to a zoo at night?
sentences.english: Most large cities have zoos , but have you ever been to a zoo at night ?
sentences.chinese: 大多数大城市都有动物园，但你可曾去过夜间动物园？

wordDetails.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成时

sentences.content: Singapore has a Night Safari.
sentences.english: Singapore has a Night Safari
sentences.chinese: 新加坡有一个夜间野生动物园。

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

sentences.content: It might seem strange to go to a zoo when it’s dark.
sentences.english: It might seem strange to go to a zoo when it's dark
sentences.chinese: 天黑时去动物园可能显得有点奇怪。

sentences.content: However, if you go to see lions, tigers or foxes during the daytime, they’ll probably be asleep!
sentences.english: However , if you go to see lions , tigers or foxes during the daytime , they'll probably be asleep !
sentences.chinese: 不过，如果你白天去看狮子、老虎或狐狸，它们很可能在睡觉！

sentences.content: A lot of animals only wake up at night, so this is the best time to watch them.
sentences.english: A lot of animals only wake up at night , so this is the best time to watch them
sentences.chinese: 许多动物只在夜间活动，因此这是观察它们的最佳时机。

sentences.content: At the Night Safari, you can watch these animals in a more natural environment than in a normal zoo.
sentences.english: At the Night Safari , you can watch these animals in a more natural environment than in a normal zoo
sentences.chinese: 在Night Safari，您可以在比普通动物园更自然的环境中观赏这些动物。

sentences.content: One great thing about Singapore is that the temperature is almost the same all year round.
sentences.english: One great thing about Singapore is that the temperature is almost the same all year round
sentences.chinese: 新加坡的一大优点是全年气温几乎保持不变。

sentences.content: This is because the island is so close to the equator.
sentences.english: This is because the island is so close to the equator
sentences.chinese: 这是因为该岛距离赤道非常近。

sentences.content: So you can choose to go whenever you like –– spring, summer, autumn or winter.
sentences.english: So you can choose to go whenever you like –– spring , summer , autumn or winter
sentences.chinese: 因此你可以随心选择出行时间——春夏秋冬皆可。

sentences.content: And, of course, it’s not too far from China!
sentences.english: And , of course , it's not too far from China !
sentences.chinese: 当然，这里离中国也不太远！
